core.changelog: Fixes a Touch Bar dimming crash and reduces refresh and drawing work in AI Activity and Weather.

community.pock.widgets.betternowplaying.changelog: Restarts the MediaRemote stream automatically when it exits during macOS login so playback appears without relaunching Pock.

community.pock.widgets.dock.changelog: Keeps running app state in sync so closed apps disappear smoothly and running-only Dock layouts stay current.
